results.content:
Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) trades at a trailing P/E of 15 with an operating margin of 14.6%. Disney is cheaper on earnings, but Netflix’s 33.4% Q2 operating margin more than doubles Disney’s, justifying the multiple premium and supporting our $101 target.

Spotify (NYSE:SPOT) trades at a trailing P/E of 51 with 777 million MAUs. Spotify carries roughly twice Netflix’s multiple on similar top-line growth, framing our 24/7 Wall St. price target as conservative.
